_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Ŋun kam yɛla Snake zaŋ ti {width}×{height} grid.
Yi niŋdi ŋun kam yɛla {player_id}. Zaasim tɛha: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (hali ni w/s/a/d).
Tɛha: yɛlimaŋli kɔɣa bee yɛla zaɣa niŋdi ŋun kam yɛla (zaasim tɛha {max_turns} zaasim).

board.current: B sẽn get b yell masã wã: {board}
board.after_moves: A sẽn be zĩig ning masã: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} kɔɣa la zuɣu niŋdi ŋun kam zɛma

outcome.survived_win: Ŋun kam yɛla {player_id}; ban kpeeni kam kɔɣa
outcome.outlived: A sẽn da maandã yɩɩ nin-kãsems a taabã fãa.
outcome.turn_limit: B sẽn ta b sẽk n na n wẽndã, yaa ned ning fãa sẽn paam-a sõma wã la a tõoge.
